# Scenarios excluded from the TCK run because they need syntax that Cypher 25
# removed. Format: feature/path.feature :: scenario name :: reason
#
# Source: the "Removals" list in the Neo4j Cypher Manual
# (deprecations-additions-removals-compatibility): Cypher 25 no longer allows a
# node or relationship on the right-hand side of SET (`SET n = r`; use
# `SET n = properties(r)`), MERGE patterns that reference another entity's
# property in the same pattern, or `$` and control characters in unescaped
# identifiers. The TCK predates these removals.
#
# Every entry must name the removed construct. Keep this list short: anything
# that is merely unsupported by graphlite belongs in unsupportedPatterns
# (tck_test.go), not here.
clauses/merge/Merge6.feature :: [6] Copying properties from node with ON CREATE :: SET with a relationship/node on the right-hand side is removed in Cypher 25 (use properties())
clauses/merge/Merge7.feature :: [4] Copying properties from node with ON MATCH :: SET with a relationship/node on the right-hand side is removed in Cypher 25 (use properties())
